lines: Shaam-e-firaaq ab na poochh, aayi aur aa ke tal gayi
couplets.en: Ask me no more of that evening apart, it came and passed.

lines: Dil tha ki phir bahal gaya, jaan thi ki phir sambhal gayi
couplets.en: The heart found comfort again, and the soul steadied itself.

lines: Shaam-e-firaaq ab na poochh, aayi aur aa ke tal gayi
couplets.en: Ask me no more of that evening apart, it came and passed.

lines: Bazm-e-khayal mein tere husn ki shama jal gayi
couplets.en: In the gathering of my thoughts, your beauty lit a candle.

lines: Dard ka chaand bujh gaya, hijr ki raat dhal gayi
couplets.en: The moon of sorrow went dark, and the night apart waned.

lines: Shaam-e-firaaq ab na poochh, aayi aur aa ke tal gayi
couplets.en: Ask me no more of that evening apart, it came and passed.

lines: Jab tujhe yaad kar liya, subh mahak mahak uthi
couplets.en: When I thought of you, the morning filled with fragrance.

lines: Jab tera gham jaga liya, raat machal machal gayi
couplets.en: When I woke the sorrow of you, the night grew restless.

lines: Shaam-e-firaaq ab na poochh, aayi aur aa ke tal gayi
couplets.en: Ask me no more of that evening apart, it came and passed.

lines: Dil se to har muaamla kar ke chale the saaf ham
couplets.en: I had settled everything with my heart before I set out.

lines: Kahne mein un ke saamne, baat badal badal gayi
couplets.en: In your presence, the words kept changing as I spoke.

lines: Shaam-e-firaaq ab na poochh, aayi aur aa ke tal gayi
couplets.en: Ask me no more of that evening apart, it came and passed.

lines: Aakhir-e-shab ke ham-safar, Faiz, na jaane kya hue
couplets.en: Who knows, Faiz, what became of our companions at night's end?

lines: Rah gayi kis jagah saba, subh kidhar nikal gayi
couplets.en: Where did the breeze linger, and where did the morning slip away?

lines: Shaam-e-firaaq ab na poochh, aayi aur aa ke tal gayi
couplets.en: Ask me no more of that evening apart, it came and passed.
